research_state.previous_question: Can the accepted Stage 1-3 components produce a source-faithful research update from one ordinary input bundle?
research_state.prior_belief: Stage 3 can render mature exact-CUHK pages when driven by engineering integration specs.
research_state.new_evidence: The bundle contains model text, simulation data, negative evidence, same-case segmentation images, and next-experiment rationale.
research_state.evidence_quality: Public-safe synthetic engineering regression evidence; suitable for integration testing but excluded from final holdouts.
research_state.belief_update: The production path should be judged on orchestration fidelity, not on final program maturity.
research_state.successes: Model, result, experiment design, negative evidence, medical comparison, and next-experiment jobs are all supported by source anchors.
research_state.failures: Small-G high-ICC imbalance remains anti-conservative, motivating the next experiment.
research_state.largest_uncertainty: Whether deck rhythm and visual repair loops can make this production output final-quality across unseen real papers.
research_state.frozen_items: Use exact CUHK Beamer source, normal gold retrieval, and Stage 3 executable layouts.
research_state.stop_items: Do not use Stage 5 holdouts or benchmark generators as the production entrypoint.
research_state.next_discriminating_experiment: Run a bounded visual-review and repair task on the production deck.
research_state.decision_needed: Decide which page-level visual findings should feed the next Stage 4 quality-loop task.
